info.title: H3 Spatial Toolkit API
info.description: Standard H3 indexing, geometry, aggregation, coverage and flow API.

deploymentCredential.name: Authorization
deploymentCredential.description: Deployment-defined credential verified by the injected authenticator.

post.description: Calculates coverage with combined input and response budgets. visitedCells plus visitedPoints must fit the batch limit; every serialized cell entry across requiredCells, visitedCells, missingCells and duplicateCells must fit the result-cell limit.

visitedCells.description: Shares the combined coverage visit limit with visitedPoints.

visitedPoints.description: Shares the combined coverage visit limit with visitedCells.
